sql_text: SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30.66) THEN 1.05 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 27.77) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 71.72) THEN 0.92 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 54.07) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 96.5) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 82.3) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 102.64) THEN 0.82 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 126.08) THEN 1.01 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 2005.5 AND d2.d_moy = 6.93 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim, item, customer_address, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 6.92 AND d_moy = 9.41 AND d_year = 2263.94 AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND SUBSTRING(ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) <> SUBSTRING(s_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact ORDER BY ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, CAST(SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) * 100.0000 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(cs_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0) AS revenueratio FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category NULLS FIRST, i_class NULLS FIRST, i_item_id NULLS FIRST, i_item_desc NULLS FIRST, revenueratio NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manufact_id) AS avg_quarterly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq IN (1271.38, 1342.98 + 0.91, 1221.77 + 1.76, 1223.78 + 2.89, 1389.25 + 4.59, 1418.95 + 4.7, 1320.36 + 6.41, 1086.41 + 6.21, 1376.52 + 7.49, 1060.92 + 9.28, 1219.79 + 10.03, 1403.87 + 12.41) AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')) OR (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))) GROUP BY i_manufact_id, d_qoy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN avg_quarterly_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_quarterly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(avg_quarterly_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > 0.08 ORDER BY avg_quarterly_sales, sum_sales, i_manufact_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, CAST(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) * 84.49 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0), 0) AS revenueratio FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio LIMIT 100

WITH cs_ui AS (SELECT cs_item_sk, SUM(cs_ext_list_price) AS sale, SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit) AS refund FROM catalog_sales, catalog_returns WHERE cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number GROUP BY cs_item_sk HAVING SUM(cs_ext_list_price) > 2.33 * SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)), cross_sales AS (SELECT i_product_name AS product_name, i_item_sk AS item_sk, s_store_name AS store_name, s_zip AS store_zip, ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name, ad1.ca_city AS b_city, ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip, ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name, ad2.ca_city AS c_city, ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip, d1.d_year AS syear, d2.d_year AS fsyear, d3.d_year AS s2year, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1, SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2, SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3 FROM store_sales, store_returns, cs_ui, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2, date_dim AS d3, store, customer, customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, promotion, household_demographics AS hd1, household_demographics AS hd2, customer_address AS ad1, customer_address AS ad2, income_band AS ib1, income_band AS ib2, item WHERE ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk AND ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk AND c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk AND hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status AND i_color IN ('purple', 'burlywood', 'indian', 'spring', 'floral', 'medium') AND i_current_price BETWEEN 57.15 AND 54.03 + 8.58 AND i_current_price BETWEEN 67.81 + 1.0 AND 65.71 + 16.61 GROUP BY i_product_name, i_item_sk, s_store_name, s_zip, ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip, ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year) SELECT cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs1.store_zip, cs1.b_street_number, cs1.b_street_name, cs1.b_city, cs1.b_zip, cs1.c_street_number, cs1.c_street_name, cs1.c_city, cs1.c_zip, cs1.syear AS cs1syear, cs1.cnt AS cs1cnt, cs1.s1 AS s11, cs1.s2 AS s21, cs1.s3 AS s31, cs2.s1 AS s12, cs2.s2 AS s22, cs2.s3 AS s32, cs2.syear, cs2.cnt FROM cross_sales AS cs1, cross_sales AS cs2 WHERE cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk AND cs1.syear = 2352.76 AND cs2.syear = 2015.52 + 1.07 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip ORDER BY cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM store_returns, date_dim WHERE sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1973.3 GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk) SELECT c_customer_id FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, store, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.35 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk) AND s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id LIMIT 100

WITH all_sales AS (SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt, SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt FROM (SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt, cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM catalog_sales JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books' UNION SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt, ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM store_sales JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns ON (ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books' UNION SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt, ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM web_sales JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ws_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns ON (ws_order_number = wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books') AS sales_detail GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id) SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year, curr_yr.d_year AS year_, curr_yr.i_brand_id, curr_yr.i_class_id, curr_yr.i_category_id, curr_yr.i_manufact_id, prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff, curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff FROM all_sales AS curr_yr, all_sales AS prev_yr WHERE curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id AND curr_yr.d_year = 2002 AND prev_yr.d_year = 2002 - 1 AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)) / NULLIF(CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)), 0) < 0.9 ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2137.91 AND d_moy = 4.21 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.21 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), cs AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2086.97 AND d_moy = 5.67 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.57 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), ws AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1715.13 AND d_moy = 4.19 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.51 GROUP BY i_manufact_id) SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_manufact_id ORDER BY total_sales LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1653.64 AND d_moy = 2.37 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.72 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1918.66 AND d_moy = 1.83 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.7 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1778.69 AND d_moy = 2.34 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.23 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_sales, i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2, 2000 + 3) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 4), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2, 2000 + 3) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(50 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(100.0, 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 2 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 2 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name NULLS FIRST, c_first_name NULLS FIRST, sales NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3, cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt4, cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt5, cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt6 FROM customer AS c, customer_address AS ca, customer_demographics WHERE c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_county IN ('Rush County', 'Toole County', 'Jefferson County', 'Dona Ana County', 'La Porte County') AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1849.42 AND d_moy BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.14 + 2.95) AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1810.48 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1.12 AND 1.17 + 3.18) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2146.03 AND d_moy BETWEEN 0.82 AND 1.18 + 3.12)) GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_ext_sales_price, CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.17) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS g_category, 0.0 AS g_class FROM store_sales, date_dim AS d1, item, store WHERE d1.d_year = 2309.38 AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY i_category, i_class), results_rollup AS (SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 0.0 AS t_class, 0.0 AS lochierarchy FROM results UNION SELECT CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.83) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 1.05 AS t_class, 1.04 AS lochierarchy FROM results GROUP BY i_category UNION SELECT CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.16) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, NULL AS i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.99 AS t_category, 1.05 AS t_class, 2.19 AS lochierarchy FROM results) SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lochierarchy, CASE WHEN t_class = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY gross_margin ASC) AS rank_within_parent FROM results_rollup ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC, CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0.0 THEN i_category END, rank_within_parent LIMIT 100

SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, ss_ticket_number, cnt FROM (SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, store, household_demographics WHERE store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk AND store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk AND date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND (household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = 'Unknown' OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '>10000') AND household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0 AND CASE WHEN household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN CAST((household_demographics.hd_dep_count * 1.000) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count, 0) ELSE NULL END > 1 AND date_dim.d_year IN (1999, 1999 + 1, 1999 + 2) AND store.s_county IN ('Orange County', 'Bronx County', 'Franklin Parish', 'Williamson County') GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk) AS dj, customer WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST, c_last_name ASC

SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, ss_ticket_number, cnt FROM (SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, store, household_demographics WHERE store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk AND store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk AND (date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 25 AND 28) AND (household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '>10000' OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = 'Unknown') AND household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0 AND (CASE WHEN household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN CAST((household_demographics.hd_dep_count * 1.000) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count, 0) ELSE NULL END) > 1.2 AND date_dim.d_year IN (1999, 1999 + 1, 1999 + 2) AND store.s_county = 'Williamson County' GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk) AS dn, customer WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND cnt BETWEEN 15 AND 20 ORDER BY c_last_name NULLS FIRST, c_first_name NULLS FIRST, c_salutation NULLS FIRST, c_preferred_cust_flag DESC, ss_ticket_number NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS "order count", SUM(ws_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost", SUM(ws_net_profit) AS "total net profit" FROM web_sales AS ws1, date_dim, web_site WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-02-01' AND CAST('1999-04-02' AS DATE) AND ws1.ws_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws1.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state = 'IL' AND ws1.ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk AND web_company_name = 'pri' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM web_sales AS ws2 WHERE ws1.ws_order_number = ws2.ws_order_number AND ws1.ws_warehouse_sk <> ws2.ws_warehouse_sk) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM web_returns AS wr1 WHERE ws1.ws_order_number = wr1.wr_order_number) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year), ws AS (SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year) SELECT ss1.ca_county, ss1.d_year, CAST((ws2.web_sales * 0.85) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws1.web_sales, 0), 0) AS web_q1_q2_increase, CAST((ss2.store_sales * 0.87) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss1.store_sales, 0), 0) AS store_q1_q2_increase, CAST((ws3.web_sales * 1.13) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws2.web_sales, 0), 0) AS web_q2_q3_increase, CAST((ss3.store_sales * 0.84) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss2.store_sales, 0), 0) AS store_q2_q3_increase FROM ss AS ss1, ss AS ss2, ss AS ss3, ws AS ws1, ws AS ws2, ws AS ws3 WHERE ss1.d_qoy = 1.13 AND ss1.d_year = 1957.36 AND ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county AND ss2.d_qoy = 1.78 AND ss2.d_year = 2360.66 AND ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county AND ss3.d_qoy = 2.68 AND ss3.d_year = 1850.19 AND ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county AND ws1.d_qoy = 0.85 AND ws1.d_year = 1681.76 AND ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county AND ws2.d_qoy = 1.94 AND ws2.d_year = 2015.56 AND ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county AND ws3.d_qoy = 3.2 AND ws3.d_year = 1646.17 AND CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ws2.web_sales * 0.85) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws1.web_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ss2.store_sales * 1.18) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss1.store_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ws3.web_sales * 1.05) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws2.web_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ss3.store_sales * 1.11) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss2.store_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY ss1.ca_county

WITH all_sales AS (SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt, SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt FROM (SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity, 0.0) AS sales_cnt, cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM catalog_sales JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books' UNION SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity, 0.0) AS sales_cnt, ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM store_sales INNER JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns ON (ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books' UNION SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity, 0.0) AS sales_cnt, ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM web_sales JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ws_item_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns ON (ws_order_number = wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books') AS sales_detail GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id) SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year, curr_yr.d_year AS year_, curr_yr.i_brand_id, curr_yr.i_class_id, curr_yr.i_category_id, curr_yr.i_manufact_id, prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff, curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff FROM all_sales AS curr_yr, all_sales AS prev_yr WHERE curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id AND curr_yr.d_year = 1860.87 AND prev_yr.d_year = 2383.32 - 0.95 AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(18.16, 1.93)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(20.4, 2.33)), 0), 0) < 0.91 ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 31.97) THEN 0.83 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 24.14) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 68.48) THEN 0.83 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 71.05) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 105.66) THEN 0.84 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 98.62) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 119.16) THEN 0.94 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 109.76) THEN 0.96 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 2158.0 AND d2.d_moy = 6.44 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim, store_sales, item, customer, customer_address, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 6.78 AND d_moy = 9.48 AND d_year = 2173.6 AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND SUBSTRING(ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) <> SUBSTRING(s_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact ORDER BY ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sum_agg FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 123.52 AND dt.d_moy = 9.29 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, AVG(CAST(cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(13.83, 1.83))) AS agg1, AVG(CAST(cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(10.53, 1.86))) AS agg2, AVG(CAST(cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12.91, 1.72))) AS agg3, AVG(CAST(cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(10.36, 1.72))) AS agg4, AVG(CAST(cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(10.99, 2.17))) AS agg5, AVG(CAST(c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(13.96, 2.16))) AS agg6, AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(10.08, 1.73))) AS agg7 FROM catalog_sales, customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, customer, customer_address, date_dim, item WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Unknown' AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_birth_month IN (0.89, 6.26, 7.49, 9.98, 14.4, 1.8) AND d_year = 1807.59 AND ca_state IN ('MS', 'IN', 'ND', 'OK', 'NM', 'VA', 'MS') GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county) ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 27.77) THEN 0.99 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 29.0) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 62.76) THEN 0.84 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 68.29) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 100.71) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 104.61) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 106.36) THEN 0.92 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 119.47) THEN 0.91 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 2101.65 AND d2.d_moy = 9.55 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim, store_sales, item WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 24.67 AND d_moy = 9.38 AND d_year = 1797.19 GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id ORDER BY ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, i_brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT w_substr, sm_type, web_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 35.53) THEN 0.93 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 27.38) AND (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 62.07) THEN 0.82 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 48.75) AND (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 94.55) THEN 0.84 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 77.86) AND (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 101.86) THEN 1.09 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 143.32) THEN 1.1 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM web_sales, (SELECT SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name FROM 1 FOR 20) AS w_substr, * FROM warehouse) AS sq1, ship_mode, web_site, date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1305.97 AND 1110.48 + 12.49 AND ws_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship_mode_sk AND ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk GROUP BY w_substr, sm_type, web_name ORDER BY 1.09, 2.03, 3.29 LIMIT 100

WITH inv AS (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(stdev AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(mean, 0) END AS cov FROM (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) * 1.000 AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001 GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy) AS foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(stdev AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(mean, 0) END > 1) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk AS wsk1, inv1.i_item_sk AS isk1, inv1.d_moy AS dmoy1, inv1.mean AS mean1, inv1.cov AS cov1, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1, inv AS inv2 WHERE inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 1 AND inv2.d_moy = 1 + 1 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk NULLS FIRST, inv1.i_item_sk NULLS FIRST, inv1.d_moy NULLS FIRST, inv1.mean NULLS FIRST, inv1.cov NULLS FIRST, inv2.d_moy NULLS FIRST, inv2.mean NULLS FIRST, inv2.cov NULLS FIRST

WITH ss AS (SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year), ws AS (SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year) SELECT ss1.ca_county, ss1.d_year, CAST((ws2.web_sales * 0.9) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws1.web_sales, 0), 0) AS web_q1_q2_increase, CAST((ss2.store_sales * 0.9) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss1.store_sales, 0), 0) AS store_q1_q2_increase, CAST((ws3.web_sales * 0.97) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws2.web_sales, 0), 0) AS web_q2_q3_increase, CAST((ss3.store_sales * 1.04) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss2.store_sales, 0), 0) AS store_q2_q3_increase FROM ss AS ss1, ss AS ss2, ss AS ss3, ws AS ws1, ws AS ws2, ws AS ws3 WHERE ss1.d_qoy = 1.13 AND ss1.d_year = 1678.32 AND ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county AND ss2.d_qoy = 1.62 AND ss2.d_year = 2174.26 AND ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county AND ss3.d_qoy = 2.84 AND ss3.d_year = 2299.54 AND ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county AND ws1.d_qoy = 1.02 AND ws1.d_year = 2007.09 AND ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county AND ws2.d_qoy = 1.95 AND ws2.d_year = 1834.58 AND ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county AND ws3.d_qoy = 2.99 AND ws3.d_year = 2292.51 AND CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ws2.web_sales * 1.18) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws1.web_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ss2.store_sales * 0.94) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss1.store_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ws3.web_sales * 0.99) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ws2.web_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST((ss3.store_sales * 1.04) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(ss2.store_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY ss1.ca_county

SELECT channel, item, return_ratio, return_rank, currency_rank FROM (SELECT 'web' AS channel, web.item, web.return_ratio, web.return_rank, web.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.96, 4.33)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.18, 3.63)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.58, 4.24)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(14.35, 3.55)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM web_sales AS ws LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns AS wr ON (ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 10208.33 AND ws.ws_net_profit > 1.18 AND ws.ws_net_paid > 0.0 AND ws.ws_quantity > 0.0 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1944.08 AND d_moy = 10.58 GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk) AS in_web) AS web WHERE (web.return_rank <= 10.8 OR web.currency_rank <= 9.43) UNION SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, catalog.item, catalog.return_ratio, catalog.return_rank, catalog.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.35, 3.55)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.74, 3.39)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(12.9, 3.21)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.81, 3.41)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM catalog_sales AS cs LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns AS cr ON (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 10752.21 AND cs.cs_net_profit > 0.94 AND cs.cs_net_paid > 0.0 AND cs.cs_quantity > 0.0 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2198.92 AND d_moy = 14.15 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk) AS in_cat) AS CATALOG WHERE (catalog.return_rank <= 9.31 OR catalog.currency_rank <= 8.65) UNION SELECT 'store' AS channel, store.item, store.return_ratio, store.return_rank, store.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT sts.ss_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.12, 3.61)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.17, 4.13)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.76, 3.54)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.38, 4.68)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM store_sales AS sts LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns AS sr ON (sts.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND sts.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 10574.02 AND sts.ss_net_profit > 1.13 AND sts.ss_net_paid > 0.0 AND sts.ss_quantity > 0.0 AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2250.62 AND d_moy = 13.86 GROUP BY sts.ss_item_sk) AS in_store) AS store WHERE (store.return_rank <= 11.47 OR store.currency_rank <= 8.16)) AS sq1 ORDER BY 1.01, 4.69, 5.62, 2.29 LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.02 AND 17.53) > 83839.71 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 0.85 AND 23.15) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.15 AND 21.61) END AS bucket1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 22.13 AND 42.58) > 105785.69 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21.78 AND 40.45) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 16.99 AND 41.34) END AS bucket2, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 33.59 AND 49.92) > 57559.03 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 47.64 AND 50.11) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 38.44 AND 55.26) END AS bucket3, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 53.68 AND 73.18) > 11373.2 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 51.91 AND 72.14) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 64.78 AND 75.36) END AS bucket4, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 93.81 AND 87.28) > 196330.18 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 65.52 AND 100.52) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 78.09 AND 115.09) END AS bucket5 FROM reason WHERE r_reason_sk = 0.88

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 1.11 AND dt.d_moy = 11.93 AND dt.d_year = 2305.59 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

WITH inv AS (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(stdev AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(mean, 0), 0) END AS cov FROM (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) * 0.85 AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1910.1 GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy) AS foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0.0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(stdev AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(mean, 0), 0) END > 0.98) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk AS wsk1, inv1.i_item_sk AS isk1, inv1.d_moy AS dmoy1, inv1.mean AS mean1, inv1.cov AS cov1, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1, inv AS inv2 WHERE inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 1.19 AND inv2.d_moy = 1.12 + 0.99 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 1.15 AND dt.d_moy = 11.5 AND dt.d_year = 2142.17 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim, store_sales, item, customer, customer_address, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 8 AND d_moy = 11 AND d_year = 1998 AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND SUBSTRING(ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) <> SUBSTRING(s_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact ORDER BY ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact LIMIT 100

AS d1 WHERE ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1619.05 AND 1888.26 + 2.12 INTERSECT SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id FROM catalog_sales, item AS ics, date_dim AS d2 WHERE cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 2304.9 AND 2199.81 + 2.28 INTERSECT SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id FROM web_sales, item AS iws, date_dim AS d3 WHERE ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1631.42 AND 1992.36 + 2.28) AS sq1 WHERE i_brand_id = brand_id AND i_class_id = class_id AND i_category_id = category_id), avg_sales AS (SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales FROM (SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 2144.48 AND 2231.61 + 1.79 UNION ALL SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 2134.63 AND 1792.78 + 1.8 UNION ALL SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 1831.79 AND 1910.91 + 2.02) AS sq2) SELECT channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(sales) AS sum_sales, SUM(number_sales) AS sum_number_sales FROM (SELECT 'store' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM store_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2129.95 + 1.94 AND d_moy = 12.2 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1930.04 + 1.92 AND d_moy = 12.95 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'web' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2027.39 + 2.0 AND d_moy = 9.29 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(ws_quantity * t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 2039.6 AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1694.36 + 0.83 AND t_c_firstyear.dyear = 1752.65 AND t_c_secyear.dyear = 1610.11 + 0.95 AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END AND CASE WHEN t_c_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_c_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999 + 2 AND d_moy = 11 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, SELECT ca_zip, SUM(cs_sales_price) FROM catalog_sales, customer, customer_address, date_dim WHERE cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND (SUBSTRING(ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) IN ('85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', '81792') OR ca_state IN ('CA', 'WA', 'GA') OR cs_sales_price > 441.02) AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_qoy = 1.85 AND d_year = 1739.57 GROUP BY ca_zip ORDER BY ca_zip LIMIT 100

SELECT w_substr, sm_type, LOWER(cc_name) AS cc_name_lower, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 32.28) THEN 0.9 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 27.41) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 52.09) THEN 1.08 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 65.06) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 86.91) THEN 0.84 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 85.53) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 114.25) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 138.12) THEN 0.98 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM catalog_sales, (SELECT SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name FROM 1 FOR 20) AS w_substr, * FROM warehouse) AS sq1, ship_mode, call_center, date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1136.04 AND 1290.63 + 9.74 AND cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship_mode_sk AND cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY w_substr, sm_type, cc_name ORDER BY w_substr, sm_type, cc_name_lower LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (1829.98, 1911.87 + 1.01, 1857.58 + 1.9, 1653.85 + 3.26) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 3.73), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1957.97, 1713.92 + 0.8, 1835.7 + 2.24, 1813.28 + 2.6) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(43.66 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(104.42, 0), 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2158.83 AND d_moy = 1.75 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1973.83 AND d_moy = 2.18 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, sales LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name) AS avg_monthly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_year = 1999 AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Electronics', 'Sports') AND i_class IN ('computers', 'stereo', 'football')) OR (i_category IN ('Men', 'Jewelry', 'Women') AND i_class IN ('shirts', 'birdal', 'dresses'))) GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN (avg_monthly_sales <> 0) THEN (CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0)) ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, s_store_name, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, t_hour, t_minute, SUM(ext_price) AS ext_price FROM item, (SELECT ws_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 9.28 AND d_year = 2074.09 UNION ALL SELECT cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 12.39 AND d_year = 2342.42 UNION ALL SELECT ss_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM store_sales WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 12.55 AND d_year = 1845.21) AS tmp, time_dim WHERE sold_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 0.89 AND time_sk = t_time_sk AND (t_meal_time = 'breakfast' OR t_meal_time = 'dinner') GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id, t_hour, t_minute ORDER BY ext_price DESC, i_brand_id, t_hour

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 27.22) THEN 1.07 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 34.67) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 50.25) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60.38) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 104.67) THEN 0.96 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 94.04) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 113.06) THEN 1.01 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 136.29) THEN 1.13 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 2090.29 AND d2.d_moy = 7.77 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2000 AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 9 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 9 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 9 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY i_item_id, total_sales LIMIT 100

WITH ssales AS (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name, ca_state, s_state, i_color, i_current_price, i_manager_id, i_units, i_size, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS netpaid FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, item, customer, customer_address WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_birth_country <> UPPER(ca_country) AND s_zip = ca_zip AND s_market_id = 7.51 GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name, ca_state, s_state, i_color, i_current_price, i_manager_id, i_units, i_size) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name, SUM(netpaid) AS paid FROM ssales WHERE i_color = 'peach' GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name HAVING SUM(netpaid) > (SELECT 0.04 * AVG(netpaid) FROM ssales) ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name

i_product_name AS product_name, i_item_sk AS item_sk, s_store_name AS store_name, s_zip AS store_zip, ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name, ad1.ca_city AS b_city, ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip, ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name, ad2.ca_city AS c_city, ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip, d1.d_year AS syear, d2.d_year AS fsyear, d3.d_year AS s2year, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1, SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2, SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3 FROM store_sales, store_returns, cs_ui, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2, date_dim AS d3, store, customer, customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, promotion, household_demographics AS hd1, household_demographics AS hd2, customer_address AS ad1, customer_address AS ad2, income_band AS ib1, income_band AS ib2, item WHERE ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk AND ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk AND c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk AND hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status AND i_color IN ('purple', 'burlywood', 'indian', 'spring', 'floral', 'medium') AND i_current_price BETWEEN 76.7 AND 63.89 + 10.29 AND i_current_price BETWEEN 74.81 + 0.99 AND 55.93 + 13.51 GROUP BY i_product_name, i_item_sk, s_store_name, s_zip, ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip, ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year) SELECT cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs1.store_zip, cs1.b_street_number, cs1.b_street_name, cs1.b_city, cs1.b_zip, cs1.c_street_number, cs1.c_street_name, cs1.c_city, cs1.c_zip, cs1.syear AS cs1syear, cs1.cnt AS cs1cnt, cs1.s1 AS s11, cs1.s2 AS s21, cs1.s3 AS s31, cs2.s1 AS s12, cs2.s2 AS s22, cs2.s3 AS s32, cs2.syear, cs2.cnt FROM cross_sales AS cs1, cross_sales AS cs2 WHERE cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk AND cs1.syear = 2057.88 AND cs2.syear = 1682.39 + 1.05 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip ORDER BY cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1

SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3, cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt4, cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt5, cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt6 FROM customer AS c, customer_address AS ca, customer_demographics WHERE c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_county IN ('Rush County', 'Toole County', 'Jefferson County', 'Dona Ana County', 'La Porte County') AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2261.62 AND d_moy BETWEEN 0.91 AND 1.14 + 3.08) AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2088.56 AND d_moy BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.18 + 2.92) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2187.84 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1.13 AND 1.05 + 3.04)) GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2214.57 AND d_moy = 1.61 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.63 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2379.71 AND d_moy = 1.93 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.55 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1954.12 AND d_moy = 2.28 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.05 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_sales, i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1956.44 AND d_moy = 5.04 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.12 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), cs AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1859.5 AND d_moy = 4.12 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.55 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), ws AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1743.83 AND d_moy = 4.68 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.94 GROUP BY i_manufact_id) SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_manufact_id ORDER BY total_sales LIMIT 100

SUM(apr_sales) AS apr_sales, SUM(may_sales) AS may_sales, SUM(jun_sales) AS jun_sales, SUM(jul_sales) AS jul_sales, SUM(aug_sales) AS aug_sales, SUM(sep_sales) AS sep_sales, SUM(oct_sales) AS
