SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sum_agg FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 103.4 AND dt.d_moy = 11.84 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

WITH ssr AS (SELECT s_store_id AS store_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS returns_, SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM store_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number), date_dim, store, promotion WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 47.02 AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS returns_, SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM catalog_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number), date_dim, catalog_page, item, promotion WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 52.42 AND cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS returns_, SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM web_sales LEFT INNER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number), date_dim, web_site, item, promotion WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 52.07 AND ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', COALESCE(store_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', COALESCE(catalog_page_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', COALESCE(web_site_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (2374.66, 2386.57 + 0.86, 1816.5 + 1.81, 1603.49 + 3.53) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 4.38), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2010.37, 2252.89 + 1.1, 1823.28 + 2.39, 1995.96 + 2.61) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(50.52 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(112.35, 0), 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1606.05 AND d_moy = 2.09 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2117.07 AND d_moy = 2.0 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, sales LIMIT 100

SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, CONCAT(COALESCE(CONCAT(COALESCE(COALESCE(c_last_name, ''), ''), ', '), ''), COALESCE(COALESCE(c_first_name, ''), '')) AS customername FROM customer, customer_address, customer_demographics, household_demographics, income_band, store_returns WHERE ca_city = 'Edgewood' AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ib_lower_bound >= 38605.14 AND ib_upper_bound <= 42655.29 + 44252.09 AND ib_income_band_sk = hd_income_band_sk AND cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk AND hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk AND sr_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, t_hour, t_minute, SUM(ext_price) AS ext_price FROM item, (SELECT ws_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 12.0 AND d_year = 1719.16 UNION ALL SELECT cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 13.11 AND d_year = 2308.57 UNION ALL SELECT ss_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 9.35 AND d_year = 2026.06) AS tmp, time_dim WHERE sold_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 0.97 AND time_sk = t_time_sk AND (t_meal_time = 'breakfast' OR t_meal_time = 'dinner') GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id, t_hour, t_minute ORDER BY ext_price DESC, i_brand_id, t_hour

SELECT channel, item, return_ratio, return_rank, currency_rank FROM (SELECT 'web' AS channel, web.item, web.return_ratio, web.return_rank, web.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(14.14, 3.78)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(14.03, 4.27)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(14.69, 4.05)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.84, 3.94)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM web_sales AS ws LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns AS wr ON (ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 9848.9 AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0.89 AND ws.ws_net_paid > 0.0 AND ws.ws_quantity > 0.0 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2069.23 AND d_moy = 12.38 GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk) AS in_web) AS web WHERE (web.return_rank <= 10.78 OR web.currency_rank <= 9.18) UNION SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, catalog.item, catalog.return_ratio, catalog.return_rank, catalog.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(13.44, 3.87)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.8, 4.13)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.67, 4.03)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.08, 3.9)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM catalog_sales AS cs LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns AS cr ON (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 9393.99 AND cs.cs_net_profit > 0.81 AND cs.cs_net_paid > 0.0 AND cs.cs_quantity > 0.0 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1604.51 AND d_moy = 12.92 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk) AS in_cat) AS CATALOG WHERE (catalog.return_rank <= 9.0 OR catalog.currency_rank <= 11.33) UNION SELECT 'store' AS channel, store.item, store.return_ratio, store.return_rank, store.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT sts.ss_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(13.08, 3.31)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(13.52, 4.68)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(12.17, 3.42)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.99, 4.67)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM store_sales AS sts LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns AS sr ON (sts.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND sts.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 11826.67 AND sts.ss_net_profit > 0.81 AND sts.ss_net_paid > 0.0 AND sts.ss_quantity > 0.0 AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1813.29 AND d_moy = 11.97 GROUP BY sts.ss_item_sk) AS in_store) AS store WHERE (store.return_rank <= 11.99 OR store.currency_rank <= 8.52)) AS sq1 ORDER BY 1.03, 3.3, 4.61, 1.64 LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_sum, i_category, i_class, GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) AS lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class), CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY SUM(ws_net_paid) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_parent FROM web_sales, date_dim AS d1, item WHERE d1.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1429.39 AND 1226.96 + 9.7 AND d1.d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ws_item_sk GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class) ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END, rank_within_parent LIMIT 100

SELECT w_state, i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS sales_before, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS sales_after FROM catalog_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk), warehouse, item, date_dim WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.92 AND 1.38 AND i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-02-10' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-04-10' AS DATE) GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount" FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE i_manufact_id = 385.43 AND i_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND ws_ext_discount_amt > (SELECT 1.55 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk) ORDER BY SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_sum, i_category, i_class, GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) AS lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class), CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY SUM(ws_net_paid) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_parent FROM web_sales, date_dim AS d1, item WHERE d1.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1221.86 AND 1395.21 + 11.72 AND d1.d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ws_item_sk GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class) ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END, rank_within_parent LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sum_agg FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 144.13 AND dt.d_moy = 12.26 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name) AS avg_monthly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_year = 1661.05 AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Electronics', 'Sports') AND i_class IN ('computers', 'stereo', 'football')) OR (i_category IN ('Men', 'Jewelry', 'Women') AND i_class IN ('shirts', 'birdal', 'dresses'))) GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN (avg_monthly_sales <> 0.0) THEN (CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0), 0)) ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, s_store_name, 1.0, 1.95, 2.79, 5.22, 7.09, 7.0, 8.87 LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 0.89 AND dt.d_moy = 12.91 AND dt.d_year = 1995.15 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT promotions, total, CAST(promotions AS DECIMAL(16.14, 3.73)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(total AS DECIMAL(12.86, 4.45)), 0), 0) * 95.43 FROM (SELECT SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS promotions FROM store_sales, store, promotion, date_dim, customer, customer_address, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.96 AND i_category = 'Jewelry' AND (p_channel_dmail = 'Y' OR p_channel_email = 'Y' OR p_channel_tv = 'Y') AND s_gmt_offset = -4.51 AND d_year = 2087.26 AND d_moy = 9.32) AS promotional_sales, (SELECT SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total FROM store_sales, store, date_dim, customer, customer_address, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.54 AND i_category = 'Jewelry' AND s_gmt_offset = -4.33 AND d_year = 1678.62 AND d_moy = 11.88) AS all_sales ORDER BY promotions, total LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 0.97 AND 17.68) > 87673.74 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.04 AND 16.38) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.07 AND 18.87) END AS bucket1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 16.84 AND 39.89) > 116881.05 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 23.11 AND 41.12) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 19.97 AND 32.13) END AS bucket2, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 48.78 AND 58.49) > 53359.34 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 39.29 AND 50.9) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 43.78 AND 60.2) END AS bucket3, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 68.18 AND 68.56) > 11981.65 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 58.13 AND 90.96) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 56.59 AND 92.33) END AS bucket4, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 69.97 AND 101.36) > 166154.19 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 94.44 AND 118.0) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 72.27 AND 89.73) END AS bucket5 FROM reason WHERE r_reason_sk = 1.06

SELECT * FROM (SELECT w_warehouse_name, i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand ELSE 0.0 END) AS inv_before, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand ELSE 0.0 END) AS inv_after FROM inventory, warehouse, item, date_dim WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 1.04 AND 1.55 AND i_item_sk = inv_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-02-10' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-04-10' AS DATE) GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, i_item_id) AS x WHERE (CASE WHEN inv_before > 0.0 THEN CAST((inv_after * 0.98) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(inv_before, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END) BETWEEN CAST(2.1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(2.44, 0), 0) AND CAST(3.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(2.14, 0), 0) ORDER BY w_warehouse_name, i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, CAST(SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) * 104.29 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(SUM(cs_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0), 0) AS revenueratio FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim, store_sales, item WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 29.95 AND d_moy = 11.37 AND d_year = 2294.0 GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id ORDER BY ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, i_brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price FROM item, inventory, date_dim, catalog_sales WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 72.22 AND 63.39 + 28.39 AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date_sk = inv_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-02-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-04-01' AS DATE) AND i_manufact_id IN (651.15, 882.42, 661.85, 739.09) AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 85.84 AND 593.27 AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price ORDER BY i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH ssales AS (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name, ca_state, s_state, i_color, i_current_price, i_manager_id, i_units, i_size, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS netpaid FROM store_sales, store, item, customer_address WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_birth_country <> UPPER(ca_country) AND s_zip = ca_zip AND s_market_id = 9.41 GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name, ca_state, s_state, i_color, i_current_price, i_manager_id, i_units, i_size) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name, SUM(netpaid) AS paid FROM ssales WHERE i_color = 'peach' GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name HAVING SUM(netpaid) > (SELECT 0.06 * AVG(netpaid) FROM ssales) ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, s_store_name

WITH cross_items AS (SELECT i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk FROM item, (SELECT iss.i_brand_id AS brand_id, iss.i_class_id AS class_id, iss.i_category_id AS category_id FROM store_sales, item AS iss, date_dim AS d1 WHERE ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 2142.48 AND 1941.97 + 2.0 INTERSECT SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id FROM catalog_sales, item AS ics, date_dim AS d2 WHERE cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 2381.0 AND 2014.12 + 2.35 INTERSECT SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id FROM web_sales, item AS iws, date_dim AS d3 WHERE ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 2146.95 AND 1922.3 + 2.03) AS sq1 WHERE i_brand_id = brand_id AND i_class_id = class_id AND i_category_id = category_id), avg_sales AS (SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales FROM (SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 2095.41 AND 2333.73 + 1.96 UNION ALL SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 2112.51 AND 2381.01 + 1.94 UNION ALL SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 2257.48 AND 2084.96 + 2.01) AS sq2) SELECT channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(sales) AS sum_sales, SUM(number_sales) AS sum_number_sales FROM (SELECT 'store' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM store_sales, item WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2350.38 + 2.04 AND d_moy = 9.46 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2160.73 + 1.68 AND d_moy = 12.65 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'web' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1743.86 + 2.05 AND d_moy = 10.06 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)) AS y GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id) ORDER BY channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, s_store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Sunday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Monday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Tuesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Wednesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Thursday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Friday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Saturday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales FROM date_dim, store_sales, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_gmt_offset = -4.28 AND d_year = 1892.4 GROUP BY s_store_name, s_store_id ORDER BY s_store_name, s_store_id, sun_sales, mon_sales, tue_sales, wed_sales, thu_sales, fri_sales, sat_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT ca_zip, SUM(cs_sales_price) FROM catalog_sales, customer_address WHERE cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND (SUBSTRING(ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) IN ('85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', '81792') OR ca_state IN ('CA', 'WA', 'GA') OR cs_sales_price > 475.13) AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_qoy = 2.12 AND d_year = 1743.6 GROUP BY ca_zip ORDER BY ca_zip LIMIT 100

WITH my_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM (SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk FROM web_sales) AS cs_or_ws_sales, item, date_dim, customer WHERE sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Women' AND i_class = 'maternity' AND c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk AND d_moy = 12.35 AND d_year = 1946.39), my_revenue AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue FROM my_customers, store_sales, customer_address, store, date_dim WHERE c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_county = s_county AND ca_state = s_state AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1.08 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1967.06 AND d_moy = 10.79) AND (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 2.61 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2215.17 AND d_moy = 12.53) GROUP BY c_customer_sk), segments AS (SELECT CAST(ROUND(CAST(revenue AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(49.36, 0), 0)) AS INT) AS SEGMENT FROM my_revenue) SELECT SEGMENT, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, SEGMENT * 59.04 AS segment_base FROM segments GROUP BY SEGMENT ORDER BY SEGMENT, num_customers, segment_base LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 0.9 AND 22.67) > 68391.9 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 0.91 AND 17.87) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.19 AND 23.55) END AS bucket1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 17.31 AND 38.02) > 112173.9 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 19.46 AND 33.12) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21.04 AND 37.05) END AS bucket2, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 38.7 AND 70.2) > 65391.38 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 39.29 AND 70.01) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 37.34 AND 66.56) END AS bucket3, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 56.97 AND 71.55) > 8577.58 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61.45 AND 93.49) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 54.05 AND 80.13) END AS bucket4, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 73.09 AND 85.19) > 167558.68 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 75.75 AND 94.39) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 86.48 AND 94.82) END AS bucket5 FROM reason WHERE r_reason_sk = 0.92

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, date_dim WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2094.23 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.15 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, CAST(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) * 102.08 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0), 0) AS revenueratio FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, sc.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand FROM store, item, (SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1277.04 AND 1312.78 + 12.29 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) AS sa GROUP BY ss_store_sk) AS sb, (SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1130.42 AND 1280.87 + 12.53 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) AS sc WHERE sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave AND s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2277.19 AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1 WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.04 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

WITH sr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty FROM store_returns, item, date_dim WHERE sr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), cr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty FROM catalog_returns, item, date_dim WHERE cr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), wr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty FROM web_returns, item, date_dim WHERE wr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((sr_item_qty * 1.0000) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(3.0000, 0) * 100 AS sr_dev, cr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((cr_item_qty * 1.0000) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(3.0000, 0) * 100 AS cr_dev, wr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((wr_item_qty * 1.0000) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(3.0000, 0) * 100 AS wr_dev, CAST((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(3.0, 0) AS average FROM sr_items, cr_items, wr_items WHERE sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id AND sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id ORDER BY sr_items.item_id NULLS FIRST, sr_item_qty NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 24.23) THEN 0.85 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 32.11) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 51.63) THEN 1.19 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 65.28) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 73.1) THEN 1.19 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 81.43) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 115.88) THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 121.35) THEN 0.82 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 2076.33 AND d2.d_moy = 9.06 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, CAST(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) * 116.47 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0), 0) AS revenueratio FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, ss_quantity AS agg1, ss_list_price AS agg2, ss_coupon_amt AS agg3, ss_sales_price AS agg4 FROM store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND d_year = 1644.25 AND s_state = 'TN') SELECT i_item_id, s_state, g_state, agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4 FROM (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id, s_state UNION ALL SELECT i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 0.85 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 1.12 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results) AS foo ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM store_returns, date_dim WHERE sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1600.94 GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk) SELECT c_customer_id FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, store, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk) AND s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT (i_product_name) FROM item AS i1 WHERE i_manufact_id BETWEEN 744.68 AND 686.73 + 34.99 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_cnt FROM item WHERE (i_manufact = i1.i_manufact AND ((i_category = 'Women' AND (i_color = 'powder' OR i_color = 'khaki') AND (i_units = 'Ounce' OR i_units = 'Oz') AND (i_size = 'medium' OR i_size = 'extra large')) OR (i_category = 'Women' AND (i_color = 'brown' OR i_color = 'honeydew') AND (i_units = 'Bunch' OR i_units = 'Ton') AND (i_size = 'N/A' OR i_size = 'small')) OR (i_category = 'Men' AND (i_color = 'floral' OR i_color = 'deep') AND (i_units = 'N/A' OR i_units = 'Dozen') AND (i_size = 'petite' OR i_size = 'petite')) OR (i_category = 'Men' AND (i_color = 'light' OR i_color = 'cornflower') AND (i_units = 'Box' OR i_units = 'Pound') AND (i_size = 'medium' OR i_size = 'extra large')))) OR (i_manufact = i1.i_manufact AND ((i_category = 'Women' AND (i_color = 'midnight' OR i_color = 'snow') AND (i_units = 'Pallet' OR i_units = 'Gross') AND (i_size = 'medium' OR i_size = 'extra large')) OR (i_category = 'Women' AND (i_color = 'cyan' OR i_color = 'papaya') AND (i_units = 'Cup' OR i_units = 'Dram') AND (i_size = 'N/A' OR i_size = 'small')) OR (i_category = 'Men' AND (i_color = 'orange' OR i_color = 'frosted') AND (i_units = 'Each' OR i_units = 'Tbl') AND (i_size = 'petite' OR i_size = 'petite')) OR (i_category = 'Men' AND (i_color = 'forest' OR i_color = 'ghost') AND (i_units = 'Lb' OR i_units = 'Bundle') AND (i_size = 'medium' OR i_size = 'extra large'))))) > 0.0 ORDER BY i_product_name LIMIT 100

WITH year_total AS (SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type FROM customer, store_sales, date_dim WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2191.76, 2297.81 + 1.03) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year UNION ALL SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ws_net_paid) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type FROM customer, web_sales, date_dim WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2037.45, 1819.08 + 1.04) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year) SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name FROM year_total AS t_s_firstyear, year_total AS t_s_secyear, year_total AS t_w_firstyear, year_total AS t_w_secyear WHERE t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_firstyear.year_ = 2295.02 AND t_s_secyear.year_ = 1681.82 + 1.02 AND t_w_firstyear.year_ = 2271.59 AND t_w_secyear.year_ = 2271.19 + 0.87 AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_w_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_w_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_s_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY 0.97 LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_ext_sales_price, CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.93) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS g_category, 0.0 AS g_class FROM store_sales, date_dim AS d1, item, store WHERE d1.d_year = 2121.25 AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY i_category, i_class), results_rollup AS (SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 0.0 AS t_class, 0.0 AS lochierarchy FROM results UNION SELECT CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.07) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 1.18 AS t_class, 0.87 AS lochierarchy FROM results GROUP BY i_category UNION SELECT CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.03) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, NULL AS i_category, NULL AS i_class, 1.06 AS t_category, 0.87 AS t_class, 2.05 AS lochierarchy FROM results) SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lochierarchy, CASE WHEN t_class = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY gross_margin ASC) AS rank_within_parent FROM results_rollup ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC, CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0.0 THEN i_category END, rank_within_parent LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, ss_quantity AS agg1, ss_list_price AS agg2, ss_coupon_amt AS agg3, ss_sales_price AS agg4 FROM store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, store, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND d_year = 1674.14 AND s_state = 'TN') SELECT i_item_id, s_state, g_state, agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4 FROM (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id, s_state UNION ALL SELECT i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 0.91 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 0.93 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results) AS foo ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_sum, i_category, i_class, GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) AS lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class), CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY SUM(ws_net_paid) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_parent FROM web_sales, date_dim AS d1, item WHERE d1.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1286.18 AND 1233.17 + 11.64 AND d1.d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ws_item_sk GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class) ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END, rank_within_parent LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2099.2 AND d_moy = 2.25 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.16 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1821.18 AND d_moy = 1.73 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.88 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2298.57 AND d_moy = 1.94 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.38 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_sales, i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manufact_id) AS avg_quarterly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq IN (1337.83, 1403.01 + 1.0, 1241.79 + 1.99, 988.97 + 2.96, 1118.91 + 4.37, 1313.83 + 4.1, 1388.62 + 7.03, 1074.08 + 7.66, 1077.5 + 7.29, 964.42 + 8.38, 1002.38 + 9.43, 1316.66 + 10.99) AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')) OR (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))) GROUP BY i_manufact_id, d_qoy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN avg_quarterly_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_quarterly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(avg_quarterly_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > 0.12 ORDER BY avg_quarterly_sales, sum_sales, i_manufact_id LIMIT 100

SELECT SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg1, AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg2, AVG(wr_fee) FROM web_sales, web_returns, web_page, customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, reason WHERE ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1750.74 AND cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk AND cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr_returning_cdemo_sk AND ca_address_sk = wr_refunded_addr_sk AND r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk AND ((cd1.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 119.45 AND 177.99) OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 41.33 AND 110.52) OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 170.12 AND 210.55)) AND ((ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('IN', 'OH', 'NJ') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 86.18 AND 207.64) OR (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('WI', 'CT', 'KY') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 170.06 AND 316.56) OR (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('LA', 'IA', 'AR') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 53.04 AND 222.26)) GROUP BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws_quantity), AVG(wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr_fee) LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, s_store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Sunday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Monday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Tuesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Wednesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Thursday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Friday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Saturday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales FROM date_dim, store_sales, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_gmt_offset = -5.45 AND d_year = 2204.01 GROUP BY s_store_name, s_store_id ORDER BY s_store_name, s_store_id, sun_sales, mon_sales, tue_sales, wed_sales, thu_sales, fri_sales, sat_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 0.87 AND dt.d_moy = 9.24 AND dt.d_year = 2314.77 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, s_store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Sunday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Monday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Tuesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Wednesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Thursday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Friday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Saturday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales FROM date_dim, store_sales, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_gmt_offset = -5.74 AND d_year = 2071.24 GROUP BY s_store_name, s_store_id ORDER BY s_store_name, s_store_id, sun_sales, mon_sales, tue_sales, wed_sales, thu_sales, fri_sales, sat_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(ss_quantity) FROM store_sales, store, customer_demographics, customer_address, date_dim WHERE s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1928.81 AND ((cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 82.66 AND 123.58) OR (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 53.56 AND 98.39) OR (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 145.57 AND 168.84)) AND ((ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('CO', 'OH', 'TX') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 0.0 AND 2155.28) OR (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('OR', 'MN', 'KY') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 157.89 AND 2644.28) OR (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('VA', 'CA', 'MS') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 44.88 AND 22376.12))

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 0.99 AND dt.d_moy = 9.46 AND dt.d_year = 2010.2 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category ORDER BY SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) DESC NULLS LAST, dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, customer_address WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1668.04 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.35 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1780.4 AND d_moy = 8.41 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.99 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2082.0 AND d_moy = 7.36 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.03 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1800.19 AND d_moy = 9.78 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.82 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY i_item_id, total_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.0 AND 16.81) > 82037.54 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.12 AND 16.95) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1.09 AND 21.3) END AS bucket1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 24.75 AND 37.4) > 110378.08 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 25.14 AND 36.55) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 22.17 AND 37.35) END AS bucket2, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 39.9 AND 55.85) > 58666.79 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 38.23 AND 71.52) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 36.13 AND 66.22) END AS bucket3, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 50.48 AND 71.75) > 10210.83 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 50.24 AND 88.33) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 65.58 AND 76.03) END AS bucket4, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 70.39 AND 111.63) > 173287.13 THEN (SELECT AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 82.26 AND 89.03) ELSE (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 86.58 AND 117.56) END AS bucket5 FROM reason WHERE r_reason_sk = 0.93

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS "order count", SUM(cs_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost", SUM(cs_net_profit) AS "total net profit" FROM catalog_sales AS cs1, date_dim, customer_address, call_center WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-01' AND CAST('2002-04-02' AS DATE) AND cs1.cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs1.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND cs1.cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk AND cc_county = 'Williamson County' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales AS cs2 WHERE cs1.cs_order_number = cs2.cs_order_number AND cs1.cs_warehouse_sk <> cs2.cs_warehouse_sk) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_returns AS cr1 WHERE cs1.cs_order_number = cr1.cr_order_number) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 35.29) THEN 1.14 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 26.25) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 53.9) THEN 1.13 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 68.53) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 75.3) THEN 1.18 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 96.98) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 104.77) THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 99.25) THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 1620.46 AND d2.d_moy = 9.0 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_manager_id, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq IN (987.4, 1430.06 + 1.16, 1251.1 + 2.12, 1384.7 + 3.46, 1137.6 + 3.81, 1250.76 + 5.58, 1134.03 + 5.98, 1333.69 + 5.75, 1311.37 + 8.44, 1148.22 + 9.42, 1232.85 + 11.09, 1285.9 + 9.27) AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')) OR (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))) GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim, store_sales, item, customer, customer_address, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 7.93 AND d_moy = 12.72 AND d_year = 1802.4 AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND SUBSTRING(ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) <> SUBSTRING(s_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact ORDER BY ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, i_brand, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id, i_manufact LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price FROM item, inventory, date_dim, catalog_sales WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 77.6 AND 64.63 + 31.08 AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date_sk = inv_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-02-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-04-01' AS DATE) AND i_manufact_id IN (811.08, 802.46, 666.65, 797.47) AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 108.5 AND 441.2 AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price ORDER BY i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH my_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM (SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk FROM web_sales) AS cs_or_ws_sales, item, date_dim, customer WHERE sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Women' AND i_class = 'maternity' AND c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk AND d_moy = 12 AND d_year = 1998), my_revenue AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue FROM my_customers, store_sales, customer_address, store, date_dim WHERE c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_county = s_county AND ca_state = s_state AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12) AND (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 3 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12) GROUP BY c_customer_sk), segments AS (SELECT CAST(ROUND(CAST(revenue AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(50, 0)) AS INT) AS SEGMENT FROM my_revenue) SELECT SEGMENT, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, SEGMENT * 50 AS segment_base FROM segments GROUP BY SEGMENT ORDER BY SEGMENT NULLS FIRST, num_customers NULLS FIRST, segment_base LIMIT 100

SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, sc.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand FROM store, item, (SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1101.45 AND 979.33 + 12.15 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) AS sa GROUP BY ss_store_sk) AS sb, (SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1183.03 AND 990.07 + 10.78 GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) AS sc WHERE sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND sc.revenue <= 0.12 * sb.ave AND s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS "order count", SUM(cs_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost", SUM(cs_net_profit) AS "total net profit" FROM catalog_sales AS cs1, date_dim, call_center WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-01' AND CAST('2002-04-02' AS DATE) AND cs1.cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs1.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND cs1.cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk AND cc_county = 'Williamson County' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales AS cs2 WHERE cs1.cs_order_number = cs2.cs_order_number AND cs1.cs_warehouse_sk <> cs2.cs_warehouse_sk) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_returns AS cr1 WHERE cs1.cs_order_number = cr1.cr_order_number) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) LIMIT 100

WITH all_sales AS (SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt, SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt FROM (SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity, 0.0) AS sales_cnt, cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM catalog_sales JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books' UNION SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity, 0.0) AS sales_cnt, ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM store_sales JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns ON (ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books' UNION SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity, 0.0) AS sales_cnt, ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt FROM web_sales LEFT JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ws_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns ON (ws_order_number = wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk) WHERE i_category = 'Books') AS sales_detail GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id) SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year, curr_yr.d_year AS year_, curr_yr.i_brand_id, curr_yr.i_class_id, curr_yr.i_category_id, curr_yr.i_manufact_id, prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt, curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff, curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff FROM all_sales AS curr_yr, all_sales AS prev_yr WHERE curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id AND curr_yr.d_year = 2035.9 AND prev_yr.d_year = 1793.8 - 0.95 AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(14.71, 2.25)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(19.06, 1.97)), 0), 0) < 0.76 ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff LIMIT 100

2121.76 AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1960.15 + 1.04 AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND t_c_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND CASE WHEN t_c_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_c_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_c_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_s_secyear.year_total AS WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2143.06 AND d_moy = 1.62 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.52 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1994.3 AND d_moy = 2.03 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.41 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2299.97 AND d_moy = 1.61 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.54 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_sales, i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_manager_id, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq IN (1199.06, 1437.56 + 0.99, 1274.39 + 1.67, 1185.04 + 3.19, 1253.64 + 4.33, 1083.24 + 5.12, 1260.92 + 6.29, 1162.29 + 7.84, 1242.13 + 9.04, 1119.98 + 10.08, 1125.77 + 10.77, 1246.3 + 9.09) AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')) OR (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))) GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0.0 THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > 0.08 ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg1, AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg2, AVG(wr_fee) FROM web_sales, web_returns, web_page, customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, customer_address, date_dim, reason WHERE ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2195.75 AND cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk AND cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr_returning_cdemo_sk AND ca_address_sk = wr_refunded_addr_sk AND r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk AND ((cd1.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 97.19 AND 126.42) OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 59.96 AND 92.56) OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 167.84 AND 225.07)) AND ((ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('IN', 'OH', 'NJ') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 96.48 AND 224.62) OR (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('WI', 'CT', 'KY') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 155.14 AND 280.38) OR (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('LA', 'IA', 'AR') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 52.91 AND 245.4)) GROUP BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws_quantity), AVG(wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr_fee) LIMIT 100

WITH year_total AS (SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type FROM customer, store_sales WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2370.89, 1978.35 + 0.88) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year UNION ALL SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ws_net_paid) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type FROM customer, web_sales, date_dim WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2189.14, 2067.64 + 1.09) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year) SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name FROM year_total AS t_s_firstyear, year_total AS t_s_secyear, year_total AS t_w_firstyear, year_total AS t_w_secyear WHERE t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_firstyear.year_ = 1757.18 AND t_s_secyear.year_ = 2392.81 + 0.87 AND t_w_firstyear.year_ = 1786.79 AND t_w_secyear.year_ = 2209.6 + 1.09 AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_w_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_w_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_s_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY 0.83 LIMIT 100

SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3, cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt4, cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt5, cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt6 FROM customer AS c, customer_address AS ca, customer_demographics WHERE c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_county IN ('Rush County', 'Toole County', 'Jefferson County', 'Dona Ana County', 'La Porte County') AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1 + 3) AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1 + 3) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1 + 3)) GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE i_manufact_id = 795.21 AND i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND cs_ext_discount_amt > (SELECT 1.09 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk) LIMIT 100

WITH inv AS (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(stdev AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(mean, 0), 0) END AS cov FROM (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) * 0.93 AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory, item WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2112.76 GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy) AS foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0.0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(stdev AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(mean, 0), 0) END > 0.82) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk AS wsk1, inv1.i_item_sk AS isk1, inv1.d_moy AS dmoy1, inv1.mean AS mean1, inv1.cov AS cov1, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1, inv AS inv2 WHERE inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 1.18 AND inv2.d_moy = 0.95 + 0.82 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov

SELECT promotions, total, CAST(promotions AS DECIMAL(14.58, 3.61)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(total AS DECIMAL(16.97, 3.86)), 0), 0) * 82.54 FROM (SELECT SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS promotions FROM store_sales, store, promotion, date_dim, customer, customer_address, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.88 AND i_category = 'Jewelry' AND (p_channel_dmail = 'Y' OR p_channel_email = 'Y' OR p_channel_tv = 'Y') AND s_gmt_offset = -5.97 AND d_year = 2180.35 AND d_moy = 13.02) AS promotional_sales, (SELECT SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total FROM store_sales, store, date_dim, customer, customer_address, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.39 AND i_category = 'Jewelry' AND s_gmt_offset = -4.29 AND d_year = 1845.9 AND d_moy = 12.98) AS all_sales ORDER BY promotions, total LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (2155.67, 2035.38 + 0.92, 2179.18 + 1.9, 2120.57 + 3.46) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 3.86), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1751.55, 1924.1 + 0.97, 1608.04 + 1.98, 1926.97 + 2.68) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(45.46 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(108.82, 0), 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1741.15 AND d_moy = 2.06 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1733.34 AND d_moy = 2.09 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, sales LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 FROM store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, item, promotion WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND (p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AND d_year = 1967.18 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, ss_quantity AS agg1, ss_list_price AS agg2, ss_coupon_amt AS agg3, ss_sales_price AS agg4 FROM store_sales, store, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND d_year = 1943.62 AND s_state = 'TN') SELECT i_item_id, s_state, g_state, agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4 FROM (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id, s_state UNION ALL SELECT i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 0.86 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 0.92 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results) AS foo ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state LIMIT 100
