WITH ssr AS (SELECT s_store_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ss_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.86, 2.04)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.87, 1.78)) AS net_loss FROM store_sales UNION ALL SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.98, 2.07)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.41, 1.63)) AS profit, sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, store WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, cs_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.9, 1.99)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(8.31, 2.13)) AS net_loss FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.36, 2.18)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.39, 1.66)) AS profit, cr_return_amount AS return_amt, cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, catalog_page WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ws_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.75, 1.95)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.37, 1.68)) AS net_loss FROM web_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.84, 1.7)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.25, 1.67)) AS profit, wr_return_amt AS return_amt, wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number)) AS salesreturns, date_dim, web_site WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', COALESCE(s_store_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', COALESCE(cp_catalog_page_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', COALESCE(web_site_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (1619.22, 1668.66 + 0.9, 2119.55 + 1.77, 1650.51 + 2.62) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 3.84), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1686.43, 2119.56 + 1.14, 2289.3 + 2.24, 2268.0 + 3.16) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(59.69 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(108.73, 0), 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2167.84 AND d_moy = 1.81 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2175.33 AND d_moy = 2.4 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, sales LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name) AS avg_monthly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_year = 1620.77 AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Electronics', 'Sports') AND i_class IN ('computers', 'stereo', 'football')) OR (i_category IN ('Men', 'Jewelry', 'Women') AND i_class IN ('shirts', 'birdal', 'dresses'))) GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN (avg_monthly_sales <> 0.0) THEN (CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0), 0)) ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, s_store_name, 1.15, 1.61, 2.56, 5.93, 6.45, 8.16, 8.63 LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC NULLS LAST) AS rk FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS sumsales FROM store_sales, date_dim, store, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1366.01 AND 1048.99 + 12.78 GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)) AS dw1) AS dw2 WHERE rk <= 94.41 ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk LIMIT 100

SELECT w_state, i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after FROM catalog_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk), warehouse, item, date_dim WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49 AND i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-02-10' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-04-10' AS DATE) GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_product_name, i_brand, i_class, i_category, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS qoh FROM inventory, date_dim, item WHERE inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1218.31 AND 1155.11 + 12.63 GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_product_name, i_brand, i_class, i_category) ORDER BY qoh, i_product_name, i_brand, i_class, i_category LIMIT 100

i_product_name AS product_name, i_item_sk AS item_sk, s_store_name AS store_name, s_zip AS store_zip, ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name, ad1.ca_city AS b_city, ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip, ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name, ad2.ca_city AS c_city, ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip, d1.d_year AS syear, d2.d_year AS fsyear, d3.d_year AS s2year, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1, SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2, SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3 FROM store_sales, store_returns, cs_ui, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2, date_dim AS d3, store, customer, customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, promotion, household_demographics AS hd1, household_demographics AS hd2, customer_address AS ad1, customer_address AS ad2, income_band AS ib1, income_band AS ib2, item WHERE ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk AND ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk AND c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk AND hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status AND i_color IN ('purple', 'burlywood', 'indian', 'spring', 'floral', 'medium') AND i_current_price BETWEEN 53.72 AND 68.18 + 10.0 AND i_current_price BETWEEN 68.21 + 0.82 AND 57.39 + 17.24 GROUP BY i_product_name, i_item_sk, s_store_name, s_zip, ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip, ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year) SELECT cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs1.store_zip, cs1.b_street_number, cs1.b_street_name, cs1.b_city, cs1.b_zip, cs1.c_street_number, cs1.c_street_name, cs1.c_city, cs1.c_zip, cs1.syear AS cs1syear, cs1.cnt AS cs1cnt, cs1.s1 AS s11, cs1.s2 AS s21, cs1.s3 AS s31, cs2.s1 AS s12, cs2.s2 AS s22, cs2.s3 AS s32, cs2.syear, cs2.cnt FROM cross_sales AS cs1, cross_sales AS cs2 WHERE cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk AND cs1.syear = 1933.98 AND cs2.syear = 1931.08 + 0.97 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip ORDER BY cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1

SELECT i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand, t_hour, t_minute, SUM(ext_price) AS ext_price FROM item, (SELECT ws_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 13.06 AND d_year = 2351.9 UNION ALL SELECT cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 9.2 AND d_year = 1623.63 UNION ALL SELECT ss_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk AS sold_item_sk, ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND d_moy = 9.12 AND d_year = 2297.24) AS tmp, time_dim WHERE sold_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id = 1.18 AND time_sk = t_time_sk AND (t_meal_time = 'breakfast' OR t_meal_time = 'dinner') GROUP BY i_brand, i_brand_id, t_hour, t_minute ORDER BY ext_price DESC, i_brand_id, t_hour

SELECT SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE i_manufact_id = 935.04 AND i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND cs_ext_discount_amt > (SELECT 1.06 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk) LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC NULLS LAST) AS rk FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS sumsales FROM store_sales, date_dim, store, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1155.67 AND 1050.77 + 9.83 GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)) AS dw1) AS dw2 WHERE rk <= 87.96 ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1847.15 AND d_moy = 2.16 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.64 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2172.66 AND d_moy = 2.11 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.04 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_color IN ('slate', 'blanched', 'burnished')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2254.83 AND d_moy = 2.06 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.52 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_sales, i_item_id LIMIT 100

SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3, cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt4, cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt5, cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt6 FROM customer AS c, customer_address AS ca, customer_demographics WHERE c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_county IN ('Rush County', 'Toole County', 'Jefferson County', 'Dona Ana County', 'La Porte County') AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1971.87 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1.12 AND 0.96 + 2.75) AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1688.24 AND d_moy BETWEEN 0.87 AND 0.87 + 2.49) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1739.26 AND d_moy BETWEEN 0.88 AND 0.81 + 2.48)) GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 1.11 AND dt.d_moy = 11.56 AND dt.d_year = 2370.91 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS "order count", SUM(cs_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost", SUM(cs_net_profit) AS "total net profit" FROM catalog_sales AS cs1, date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-01' AND CAST('2002-04-02' AS DATE) AND cs1.cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs1.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND cs1.cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk AND cc_county = 'Williamson County' AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales AS cs2 WHERE cs1.cs_order_number = cs2.cs_order_number AND cs1.cs_warehouse_sk <> cs2.cs_warehouse_sk) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_returns AS cr1 WHERE cs1.cs_order_number = cr1.cr_order_number) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM store_returns, date_dim WHERE sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1618.76 GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk) SELECT c_customer_id FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, store, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.19 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk) AND s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 FROM store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, item, promotion WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND (p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AND d_year = 1757.38 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1806.93 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.33 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, ss_quantity AS agg1, ss_list_price AS agg2, ss_coupon_amt AS agg3, ss_sales_price AS agg4 FROM store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, store, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND d_year = 1779.73 AND s_state = 'TN') SELECT i_item_id, s_state, g_state, agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4 FROM (SELECT i_item_id, s_state, 0.0 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id, s_state UNION ALL SELECT i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 0.98 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results GROUP BY i_item_id UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS i_item_id, NULL AS s_state, 0.89 AS g_state, AVG(agg1) AS agg1, AVG(agg2) AS agg2, AVG(agg3) AS agg3, AVG(agg4) AS agg4 FROM results) AS foo ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state LIMIT 100

SELECT cc_call_center_id AS Call_Center, cc_name AS Call_Center_Name, cc_manager AS Manager, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS Returns_Loss FROM call_center, catalog_returns, date_dim, customer, customer_address, customer_demographics, household_demographics WHERE cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk AND cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cr_returning_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk AND hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 11 AND ((cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')) AND hd_buy_potential LIKE 'Unknown%' AND ca_gmt_offset = -7 GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_manager, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status ORDER BY SUM(cr_net_loss) DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name) AS avg_monthly_sales FROM item, store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_year = 1834.39 AND ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Electronics', 'Sports') AND i_class IN ('computers', 'stereo', 'football')) OR (i_category IN ('Men', 'Jewelry', 'Women') AND i_class IN ('shirts', 'birdal', 'dresses'))) GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy) AS tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN (avg_monthly_sales <> 0.0) THEN (CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0), 0)) ELSE NULL END > 0.11 ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, s_store_name, 1.18, 1.82, 2.78, 5.67, 5.24, 6.82, 8.71 LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2266.4 AND d_moy = 5.64 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.5 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), cs AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2244.74 AND d_moy = 4.61 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.1 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), ws AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2251.72 AND d_moy = 4.18 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.0 GROUP BY i_manufact_id) SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_manufact_id ORDER BY total_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT channel, item, return_ratio, return_rank, currency_rank FROM (SELECT 'web' AS channel, web.item, web.return_ratio, web.return_rank, web.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(12.79, 3.96)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.92, 3.62)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(12.01, 4.58)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.03, 3.64)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM web_sales AS ws LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns AS wr ON (ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 10460.54 AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0.82 AND ws.ws_net_paid > 0.0 AND ws.ws_quantity > 0.0 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2360.17 AND d_moy = 9.82 GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk) AS in_web) AS web WHERE (web.return_rank <= 11.75 OR web.currency_rank <= 8.55) UNION SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, catalog.item, catalog.return_ratio, catalog.return_rank, catalog.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(14.4, 3.24)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.18, 3.38)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.64, 3.7)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(14.49, 3.93)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM catalog_sales AS cs LEFT INNER JOIN catalog_returns AS cr ON (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 11037.25 AND cs.cs_net_profit > 1.03 AND cs.cs_net_paid > 0.0 AND cs.cs_quantity > 0.0 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1752.63 AND d_moy = 12.05 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk) AS in_cat) AS CATALOG WHERE (catalog.return_rank <= 10.01 OR catalog.currency_rank <= 9.41) UNION SELECT 'store' AS channel, store.item, store.return_ratio, store.return_rank, store.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT sts.ss_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.77, 4.48)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.79, 3.23)), 0), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(13.76, 4.79)) / NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.43, 4.71)), 0), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM store_sales AS sts LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns AS sr ON (sts.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND sts.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 8754.53 AND sts.ss_net_profit > 1.07 AND sts.ss_net_paid > 0.0 AND sts.ss_quantity > 0.0 AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1679.05 AND d_moy = 13.09 GROUP BY sts.ss_item_sk) AS in_store) AS store WHERE (store.return_rank <= 10.08 OR store.currency_rank <= 8.32)) AS sq1 ORDER BY 1.02, 4.3, 5.34, 1.89 LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 0.85 AND dt.d_moy = 11.65 AND dt.d_year = 1980.35 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, ext_price DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT w_warehouse_name, i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand ELSE 0.0 END) AS inv_before, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2000-03-11' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand ELSE 0.0 END) AS inv_after FROM inventory, warehouse, item, date_dim WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 1.1 AND 1.31 AND i_item_sk = inv_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-02-10' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-04-10' AS DATE) GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, i_item_id) AS x WHERE (CASE WHEN inv_before > 0.0 THEN CAST((inv_after * 1.01) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(inv_before, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END) BETWEEN CAST(2.05 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(3.45, 0), 0) AND CAST(2.8 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(2.26, 0), 0) ORDER BY w_warehouse_name, i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (1954.13, 2344.03 + 1.16, 2381.15 + 2.16, 1725.55 + 2.47) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 3.55), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1868.29, 1723.13 + 0.98, 1657.03 + 1.96, 1655.75 + 2.76) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(47.43 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(92.13, 0), 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1840.88 AND d_moy = 2.4 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1889.21 AND d_moy = 1.64 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, sales LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC NULLS LAST) AS rk FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS sumsales FROM store_sales, date_dim, store, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1118.08 AND 1048.17 + 10.74 GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)) AS dw1) AS dw2 WHERE rk <= 81.99 ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2279.83 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.38 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (2148.52, 1841.44 + 0.87, 2137.06 + 2.11, 2177.15 + 3.39) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 4.62), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1904.01, 2149.75 + 0.83, 1762.23 + 2.14, 2156.35 + 3.21) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(54.55 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(111.83, 0), 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1867.72 AND d_moy = 1.97 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2311.66 AND d_moy = 1.7 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, sales LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sum_agg FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 128 AND dt.d_moy = 11 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC NULLS LAST, brand_id LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2288.69 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.4 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC NULLS LAST) AS rk FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS sumsales FROM store_sales, date_dim, store WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1260.99 AND 1273.15 + 9.67 GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)) AS dw1) AS dw2 WHERE rk <= 102.0 ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1794.98 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.43 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(ss_quantity) FROM store_sales, store, customer_demographics, customer_address, date_dim WHERE s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2000 AND ((cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00) OR (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00) OR (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)) AND ((ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('CO', 'OH', 'TX') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 0 AND 2000) OR (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('OR', 'MN', 'KY') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 3000) OR (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('VA', 'CA', 'MS') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 25000))

SELECT SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE i_manufact_id = 943.73 AND i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND cs_ext_discount_amt > (SELECT 1.52 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-01-27' AND CAST('2000-04-26' AS DATE) AND d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk) LIMIT 100

WITH year_total AS (SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type FROM customer, store_sales, date_dim WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1630.0, 1878.64 + 1.19) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year UNION ALL SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ws_net_paid) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type FROM customer, web_sales, date_dim WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1827.21, 2244.43 + 0.81) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year) SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name FROM year_total AS t_s_firstyear, year_total AS t_s_secyear, year_total AS t_w_firstyear, year_total AS t_w_secyear WHERE t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_firstyear.year_ = 1891.69 AND t_s_secyear.year_ = 2155.28 + 0.88 AND t_w_firstyear.year_ = 1653.62 AND t_w_secyear.year_ = 1610.26 + 0.94 AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 AND CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_w_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_w_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0.0 THEN CAST(t_s_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 0), 0) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY 0.93 LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, CAST(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) * 112.01 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0), 0) AS revenueratio FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio LIMIT 100

SELECT ca_zip, ca_city, SUM(ws_sales_price) FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, item WHERE ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND (SUBSTRING(ca_zip FROM 1 FOR 5) IN ('85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', '81792') OR i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_item_sk IN (1.64, 2.41, 4.97, 7.42, 11.06, 14.34, 16.46, 15.86, 18.49, 28.91))) AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_qoy = 1.79 AND d_year = 2382.9 GROUP BY ca_zip, ca_city ORDER BY ca_zip, ca_city LIMIT 100

WITH my_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM (SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk FROM web_sales) AS cs_or_ws_sales, item, date_dim, customer WHERE sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Women' AND i_class = 'maternity' AND c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk AND d_moy = 11.48 AND d_year = 2196.92), my_revenue AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue FROM my_customers, store_sales, customer_address, store, date_dim WHERE c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_county = s_county AND ca_state = s_state AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 0.95 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1746.82 AND d_moy = 12.2) AND (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 3.02 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2309.79 AND d_moy = 10.05) GROUP BY c_customer_sk), segments AS (SELECT CAST(ROUND(CAST(revenue AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(41.61, 0), 0)) AS INT) AS SEGMENT FROM my_revenue) SELECT SEGMENT, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, SEGMENT * 40.77 AS segment_base FROM segments GROUP BY SEGMENT ORDER BY SEGMENT, num_customers, segment_base LIMIT 100

SELECT i_product_name, i_brand, i_class, i_category, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS qoh FROM inventory, date_dim, item WHERE inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1355.11 AND 1216.95 + 9.38 GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_product_name, i_brand, i_class, i_category) ORDER BY qoh, i_product_name, i_brand, i_class, i_category LIMIT 100

SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) FROM date_dim AS dt, store_sales, item WHERE dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manager_id = 1.15 AND dt.d_moy = 11.37 AND dt.d_year = 2207.37 GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category ORDER BY SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) DESC NULLS LAST, dt.d_year, item.i_category_id, item.i_category LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_ext_sales_price, CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.01) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS g_category, 0.0 AS g_class FROM store_sales, date_dim AS d1 WHERE d1.d_year = 1696.1 AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY i_category, i_class), results_rollup AS (SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 0.0 AS t_class, 0.0 AS lochierarchy FROM results UNION SELECT CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.03) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 0.92 AS t_class, 0.87 AS lochierarchy FROM results GROUP BY i_category UNION SELECT CAST((SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.94) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0), 0) AS gross_margin, NULL AS i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.81 AS t_category, 1.1 AS t_class, 2.01 AS lochierarchy FROM results) SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lochierarchy, CASE WHEN t_class = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY gross_margin ASC) AS rank_within_parent FROM results_rollup ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC, CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0.0 THEN i_category END, rank_within_parent LIMIT 100

SELECT w_substr, sm_type, LOWER(cc_name) AS cc_name_lower, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 32.93) THEN 1.18 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 24.09) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 57.64) THEN 1.03 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 63.26) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 93.07) THEN 0.91 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 107.62) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 138.27) THEN 0.88 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 125.13) THEN 1.08 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM catalog_sales, (SELECT SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name FROM 1 FOR 20) AS w_substr, * FROM warehouse) AS sq1, ship_mode, call_center, date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 969.15 AND 1201.28 + 10.99 AND cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship_mode_sk AND cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY w_substr, sm_type, cc_name ORDER BY w_substr, sm_type, cc_name_lower LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price FROM item, date_dim, store_sales WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 64.08 AND 54.93 + 29.34 AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date_sk = inv_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-05-25' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-07-24' AS DATE) AND i_manufact_id IN (124.61, 296.2, 816.56, 497.44) AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 107.78 AND 562.22 AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price ORDER BY i_item_id LIMIT 100

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (2363.16, 1986.88 + 1.05, 1704.67 + 1.7, 2252.86 + 2.93) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 3.33), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2176.26, 2375.69 + 0.82, 1995.45 + 1.69, 2321.43 + 2.76) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(44.25 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(84.18, 0), 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1862.4 AND d_moy = 2.2 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1958.91 AND d_moy = 1.68 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name, c_first_name, sales LIMIT 100

SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3, cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt4, cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt5, cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt6 FROM customer AS c, customer_address AS ca, customer_demographics WHERE c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_county IN ('Rush County', 'Toole County', 'Jefferson County', 'Dona Ana County', 'La Porte County') AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1703.28 AND d_moy BETWEEN 0.93 AND 0.84 + 3.21) AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2041.29 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1.15 AND 1.02 + 2.74) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2383.97 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1.01 AND 1.09 + 2.62)) GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count LIMIT 100
